events.title: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.region: Sarasota, FL
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in Florida...

Myakka River At Myakka River State Park affecting Sarasota County.

...The Flood Warning is cancelled for the following rivers in
Florida...

Withlacoochee At US 41 Dunnellon affecting Levy, Marion and Citrus
Counties.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is occurring and minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Myakka River at Myakka River State Park.

* WHEN...Until Thursday afternoon.

* IMPACTS...At 7.3 feet, Picnic areas and adjacent parking lots
flood.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 9:00 AM EDT Tuesday the stage was 7.1 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 7.0 feet.
- Recent Activity...The maximum river stage in the 24 hours ending
at 9:00 AM EDT Tuesday was 7.1 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to rise to a crest of 7.2 feet
this afternoon. It will then fall below flood stage Thursday
morning.
- Flood stage is 7.0 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 7.2
feet on 12/28/2002.
- https://www.weather.gov/safety/flood

events.region: Brantley, GA
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in southeast
Georgia...

Satilla River At Atkinson affecting Brantley County.

Additional information is available at
https://water.weather.gov/wfo/JAX

The next statement will be issued Wednesday morning at 945 AM EDT.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is occurring and minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Satilla River at Atkinson.

* WHEN...Until further notice.

* IMPACTS...At 13.0 feet, Warners Landing, Louis Landing and
secondary roads around KOA campgrounds begin to flood. At 14.0
feet, River Rock Road begins to experience flooding across the
road.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 8:45 AM EDT Tuesday the stage was 13.7 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to rise to 14.5 feet Friday
morning. Additional rises are possible thereafter.
- Flood stage is 13.0 feet.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood

events.summary:
* WHAT...For the first Small Craft Advisory, east winds 15 to 25

20 to 30 kt with gusts up to 35 kt and seas 6 to 9 ft
expected. For the first Gale Warning, east winds 25 to 35 kt
with gusts up to 50 kt and seas 9 to 14 ft expected. For the
third Small Craft Advisory, east winds 25 to 35 kt with gusts
up to 45 kt and seas 13 to 18 ft expected. For the second Gale
Warning, east winds 25 to 35 kt with gusts up to 40 kt and
seas 14 to 19 ft expected. For the additional Small Craft
Advisory, southeast winds 20 to 30 kt with gusts up to 40 kt
and seas 12 to 17 ft expected.

* WHERE...Icy Cape to Cape Suckling out to 15 NM.

* WHEN...For the first Small Craft Advisory, from 10 AM this
morning to 6 PM AKDT this evening. For the second Small Craft
Advisory, from 4 PM to 10 PM AKDT Wednesday. For the first
Gale Warning, from 10 PM Wednesday to 4 AM AKDT Thursday. For
the third Small Craft Advisory, from 4 AM to 10 AM AKDT
Thursday. For the second Gale Warning, from 10 AM to 4 PM AKDT
Thursday. For the additional Small Craft Advisory, from 4 PM
Thursday to 4 AM AKDT Friday.

* IMPACTS...Strong winds will cause hazardous seas which could
capsize or damage vessels and reduce visibility.
